scope: 298 executed entries; demand inputs end on the completed breakout signal bar; future bars are labels only
method: Compare gap, close return, intraday return, high return, range expansion, close location, pivot clearance and volume expansion as continuous distributions. No composite score, classifier or threshold selection.

year_stability.note: Several yearly winner/no-follow cells are small; 2026 is partial. This is descriptive stability evidence, not an acceptance threshold.

interpretation: Breakout volume has a plausible but unstable relationship with immediate follow-through. Price-bar strength measures add essentially no separation. Raising the existing volume threshold after observing this interval would be parameter fitting.
next_action: Audit causal company-growth and industry-leadership inputs required by the fuller SEPA/VCP thesis. Continue only with fields whose historical coverage and announcement-time semantics can be demonstrated.
